entities.name: Avram Garrisson
entities.description: Former knight of Kjeldor and leader of the Order of Stromgald, later an undead servant of Lim-Dul.

entities.name: Kjeldor
entities.description: Nation whose armies Garrisson informally led.

entities.name: Order of Stromgald
entities.description: Order of Kjeldoran betrayers named after Marton Stromgald.

entities.name: Darien
entities.description: New king of Kjeldor, thought weak by Garrisson.

entities.name: Varchild
entities.description: Garrisson's appointed aide, who opposed him.

entities.name: Lim-Dul
entities.description: Necromancer allied with Garrisson who raised him as undead.

entities.name: Marton Stromgald
entities.description: Kjeldoran hero reanimated by Lim-Dul as an undead servant.

entities.name: Mikkel
entities.description: Village attacked by Lim-Dul's forces in 2934 AR.

entities.name: Gustha Ebbasdotter
entities.description: Mage who died after expending her spells against Garrisson.

events.summary: Garrisson allies with Lim-Dul to overthrow Darien and forms the Order of Stromgald.
events.quote: working with the necromancer to overthrow Darien.

events.summary: Jodah and Jaya thwart the plan; Garrisson and followers flee to Lim-Dul, are killed and added to his zombie army.
events.quote: they were killed and added to the necromancer 's zombie army.

events.summary: The undead Garrisson leads attack on Mikkel but is driven off.
events.quote: the undead Garrisson led Lim-Dûl's forces in attacking the village of Mikkel

events.summary: At Lim-Dul's Battle Garrisson goads Gustha into expending her spells, leading to her death.
Garrisson duels Varchild but is interrupted by an eruption; he is killed and his body burned.
events.quote: The undead Garrisson was killed in this battle, and his body was burned on a pyre.

relations.quote: the leader of the Order of Stromgald
willing to listen to and ally himself with Lim-Dûl

relations.note: thought him weak and tried to overthrow him
relations.quote: he thought of the new king Darien as weak.
His appointed aide, Captain Varchild , was also against him
